mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 31 degrees at Verona Community Park. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has several election notices posted for the upcoming season, and the Plan Commission is preparing to review new development projects at Liberty Business Park, including site plans for Sub-Zero.

There is plenty to do in our city, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and performances at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or a John Denver tribute concert.
Regarding the latest police report, on October 25, officers responded to a situation where a driver was found passed out at an intersection and subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Enjoy the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake flavor of the day today. Please note the restaurant is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM today.
